units.source_text: 对于禅僧也有肉体这点，我感到不可思议。

en.t: I found it strange that even Zen monks had bodies.

units.source_text: 老师极嫖色之能事，可能是为了舍离肉体，轻蔑肉体吧。

en.t: Perhaps the master exhausted every possibility of debauchery in order to cast off the body and hold it in contempt.

units.source_text: 可是，这被轻蔑的肉体却能充分地吸取营养，腻腻润润，把老师的精神包裹起来，简直令人难以想像。

en.t: Yet this despised body was able to take in nourishment fully, grow oily and moist, and wrap the master's spirit within it; it was almost impossible to imagine.

units.source_text: 这是像驯服的家畜那样温顺的、谦让的肉体。

en.t: It was a docile, yielding body, as gentle as a domesticated animal.

units.source_text: 对于和尚的精神来说，这是像传妾一样的肉体……

en.t: For the monk's spirit, it was a body like a concubine handed down to him...
